_note: Every sentence the UI shows. Tokens: {A}/{a} first creature (sentence start / mid sentence), {B}/{b} second creature, {days}, {n}, {item}, {kind}, {name}.
ui.start: Pick something below, then tap the field.
ui.zoom: Zoom: slide up to come closer
ui.oops: Something went wrong in this world, so it stopped. Tap ☰ to start a new one.
ui.backAgain: Go back again to leave this world.
hint.fav: Kept in ★. Hold it again to take it off.
ui.snap: Snapshot: tap to keep this moment, hold to go back to it
hint.snapTaken: Snapshot kept. Hold the camera button to come back to it.
hint.snapBack: Back to your snapshot. Undo goes forward again.
hint.cleared: The world is clear. Undo brings it all back.
ui.tool: Your tool: {name}. Tap for the Hand.
hint.sprayOn: Spray on: drag to lay a trail of them.
hint.sprayOff: Spray off: tap to place one; drag to look around.
hint.hand: Tap to poke. Hold to pick up. Drag to look around.
hint.land: Drag on the field to paint terrain.
hint.creature: Tap to drop one in. Hold still a moment, then drag, to drop lots.
hint.water: Put these in water. Hold still a moment, then drag, for lots. Fish dry out on land; frogs, ducks, turtles and crabs can do both.
hint.enemy: Tap to unleash one, or hold still then drag for lots. Enemies only hunt humans when Safe is off, in the Powers tab.
hint.weapon: Tap a creature to arm it, or tap the ground to lay it down.
hint.gear: Tap a creature to dress it, or tap the ground to put it down.
hint.build: Tap to build one. Hold still a moment, then drag, to build a row. Bridges go on water.
hint.inspect: Tap a creature to follow how it is doing.
hint.erase: Eraser on: tap or drag over humans, creatures, enemies, buildings, or land to get rid of them.
hint.sunbeam: A patch of sunshine: it melts, dries and grows things.
hint.storm: A storm cloud. Stand clear, or plant a lightning rod.
hint.seeds: A handful of seeds. What grows depends on the ground.
hint.gust: A puff of wind. Hats fly off and everybody hops back.
hint.bless: Tap a creature and nothing can hurt it for 30 seconds. Tap rock and a crystal grows; tap bare ground for flowers, or a field to bring it on.
hint.clone: Tap a creature to copy it, gear and all.
hint.love: Tap near creatures to make them pair up.
hint.freeze: Tap to freeze everything nearby for 8 seconds.
hint.fireball: Tap to burn a small area.
hint.meteor: Tap to drop a meteor. It leaves a crater.
hint.heal: Tap a creature to heal and feed it.
